shots.what_happens: A fighting-game style versus card: two diagonal bands (green top, pink bottom) with speed-line streaks, the Duo plush photo cut-out in the green band and the Oscar plush cut-out in the pink band, both with a pale sticker outline. Across the sheet the cut-outs and title shift and scale a little, like a slow push, and the whole card is tilted on the diagonal.

shots.build_rebuild: Film the mascot plush centred against a seamless coloured backdrop behind the board at a low eye-level lens with shallow depth of field, and move the camera laterally so the blurred foreground pieces cross the frame.

A swoosh_reverse SFX (x003) sits on the whip.
shots.build_rebuild: Whip-pan from the first player's set to a mirrored set of the opponent (swap backdrop colour pink to green), adding about 6 frames of horizontal motion blur and a reverse-swoosh sound effect on the move.

shots.build_rebuild: Hold a static, frame-filling close-up of the character's face for about 1 s, cut on the beat as a reaction punch-in between two wider shots.
